usages.value:
Hafner expects to employ 300 to 700 construction workers at any given time.
"We expect 20 to 25 people working directly at the plant, and these projects typically create 75 or so indirect jobs," like landscaping and maintenance, he said.

Each project is expected to support significant skilled trades and construction workers during peak construction: more than 800 jobs in Handy Township and more than 450 in Milan Township. 

Once the plants are operating, they are expected to support about 30 to 40 full-time positions, including operations, maintenance, engineering, environmental and administrative roles. Qualified local residents would be eligible to apply for available positions through DTE’s normal hiring process.
